text:
support-esc: FYI — ACME reports a burst of 429s on their dedicated route. They say the pool didn’t scale up quickly; min_replicas stayed at 2 and queues grew. Logs show a bunch of attach failures: `403 billing/account_suspended` and `attach backoff: auth_quota`.

maria: Can you paste repro steps and the exact error snippet? Need to route to infra if it's our attach flow.

support-esc: Steps from customer: 1) send 1000 concurrent requests to /v1/generate 2) observe 429s after ~90s 3) check dedicated console -> pool shows 2/2 ready, pending attach attempts. Error lines: `AttachManager: attach failed for pod p-42: 403 (billing/account_suspended)`, then `Autoscaler: gating scaleup: attach_failure_count > threshold`.

jon: @maria @lucy that gating is new-ish — autoscaler will not scale past probe if model attach fails repeatedly. If attach returns a non-transient auth error we currently treat it like a hard failure and stop scaleups.

lucy: Can you grab the autoscaler logs (`/var/log/redwood/autoscaler.log`) around the window? Also check registry events — maybe the model registry rejected the pull due to account state.

support-esc: Pasted tail of logs: ```
[1742506801] AttachManager: start attach model=redwood-open-7b pod=p-42
[1742506802] RegistryClient: pull -> 403 billing/account_suspended id=tok_xxx
[1742506802] AttachManager: attach failed transient=false retryable=false
[1742506805] Autoscaler: scaleup gated (reason=attach_failure_count threshold=3)
```

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-587 (sev3) — assigned to eng-infra.

sam: Long-term we should differentiate attach failures: billing/auth are customer-side and we should still provision extra nodes and mark them as degraded rather than gating further. Short-term workaround: manual scale up or bump min_replicas.

maria: Did support try manual scale? Customer says they requested a manual bump to 4 replicas around +8m and 429s stopped shortly after. They also cleared the billing hold at +12m and attach succeeded. Sequence sounds like billing hold prevented attach which then prevented autoscaler from scaling beyond gating threshold.

jon: Repro idea: simulate registry returning 403 during model pull and see autoscaler behavior. I’ll run a local integration with failing registry plugin and a fake billing code path.

lucy: Work items: 1) make autoscaler treat non-attach errors as "attach-warning" so scaleups can continue (feature flag) 2) surface attach failure reason in console alerts (billing vs quota vs transient) 3) add a fallback to use a compatible hosted variant when attach fails. I’ll open PRs.

support-esc: Customer timeline for ticket: initial 429s at 1742506790, manual bump requested at 1742506870, billing cleared at 1742506925, full recovery at 1742506998. Impact window ~8 minutes, spike caused a few hundred failed calls.

sam: PR draft: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge_requests/321 (WIP) — implements attach-warning path + feature flag `autoscaler.allow_scale_on_attach_warnings`. Tests included.

maria: Noted. Support to customer: we've identified attach failures due to a billing hold causing attach to return 403. Short-term workaround is raising min_replicas or manual scale; engineering will ship a guarded change to allow scaleups to continue despite attach warnings behind a FF.

sre-bot: Update: INC-2024-587 assigned -> eng-infra, linked to MR 321.

support-esc: Closing loop: ACME confirmed mitigation worked. Leaving incident open until FF is live.
